description: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of messages it receives
Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected
Measures to detect and recover from a denial of service attack shall be employed
Measures to prevent and detect unauthorized access shall be employed
Measures to protect systems against embedded viruses/malware should be considered
Measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity should be considered
Secure software update procedures shall be employed
Integrity protection of software shall be employed
Security controls shall be implemented for storing cryptographic keys e.g. Security Modules
Measures shall be implemented for defining and controlling user roles and access rights
Security awareness and training shall be provided
Systems should be designed to resist tampering
Cryptographic controls shall be applied to protect communication confidentiality and integrity
Access control techniques and designs shall be applied to protect system data/code. Example Security Controls can be found in OWASP
Network segmentation and boundary protection shall be applied to isolate critical vehicle networks
Security testing and verification shall be performed during development
Vulnerability management and incident response processes shall be implemented
